items.prompt: Which setup matches binomial(n,p) for a success count?

options.why: Both the independent-trials and common-p assumptions are required.

options.text: Any set of correlated binary outcomes
options.why: Dependence can change the count distribution.

options.text: Any continuous variable with a symmetric center
options.why: A binomial count has bounded integer support.

options.text: An unlimited event count with no declared exposure
options.why: That does not specify the fixed-trial binomial model.

items.explanation: The distribution follows from the stated fixed-n independent Bernoulli mechanism, not simply from seeing successes and failures.
